Shrouded in neo-classical design with artistic Vietnamese touches, Apricot’s 123 elegant rooms exude luxury in an inviting and intimate atmosphere. Services offered In addition to the 5-star accommodation service, there are countless things that guests will remember about their stay at Apricot Hotel. Guests can enjoy a cozy breakfast at L’Artiste Restaurant, a luxurious dinner at Palette Restaurant, be immersed in the delicious afternoon tea at A’telier Lounge, relax at the peaceful Spa L’Art, or sip on a cocktail while adoring a sweeping view of the historic Hoan Kiem Lake at Rooftop Bar One36.
